next.reason: 1985: 'Sequential organization is a permanent logical file structure in which a record is identified by a predecessor-successor relationship established when the record is placed into the file.' A 1985 sequential file is a 2023 record sequential file (§2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR6 'sequential organization with the RECORD SEQUENTIAL phrase is implied'), and §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR3 repeats the definition word for word. §2023:12.4.5.5.3 GR2 a) and §2023:14.9.51.4 GR17 restate that WRITE sets the relationship. GR3's sentence on record-length headers is physical, not observable. LINE SEQUENTIAL is new syntax of the clause format record. Same requirement.
